storage_scope: All newly created run-root files, private data, source copies, caches, logs and audit output; shared existing model/environment read-only. External neutral entry files covered by reserve.
assistance: Explicit calculator identity, patient, episode and output convention. Visible facts from distributed root_inputs; no gold answers or reference bindings in solver inputs.
data_limits: All source tasks previously model-evaluated; anchors not fresh confirmation
Disjoint source-task groups do not establish independent biological patients
Generated timestamp/sample metadata are hints; explicit field/value text authoritative
interface: One binding per parameter with value, fact_ids, transformation. Current profile accepts direct facts and fact-supported numeric transformations; result dependencies supported only for explicit sPESI category derivation. No general calculation dependency graph.
formula_policy: Named pinned profiles, unchanged formula bodies. Every clinical parameter explicit; computational options outside a named profile omitted with documented library defaults. No nullable placeholder or imputed clinical value.
source_policy: Current patient and output episode; only consistent same-patient Sex for corrected_qt can use another episode. Executor checks structure; evaluator independently audits semantic support.
submission: Model must explicitly submit immutable result_id, or abstain/fail with reason. No output override, forced submission or after-run repair.
context: Preamble, compact state, last three complete assistant/tool blocks; older observations retrievable, raw history retained
audit: Every accepted raw and derived computation reviewed, including those not submitted. Numeric correctness and trusted correctness reported separately; free-text transformations manually checked against visible facts. Unresolved semantic evidence never defaulted correct.
numeric_tolerance: max(0.1, 2 percent of benchmark scalar); classes exact; trusted additionally requires frozen parameter/source/lineage audit and transformation review
stop_conditions: A0 or CPU path failure prevents model launch
One pass only; no target retry, replacement, reselection, prompt/schema change or extra smoke model calls
Unexpected runtime/provider/protocol/identity/guard failure stops the run; budget stops retain all 18 in denominator
At hard budget stop, save minimal evidence and terminate owned worker
Audit unfinished after one hour: NEEDS_REVIEW
Stop after report and GitHub delivery even if PASS; HCL not authorized
future_blocker: Fresh 24-target confirmation panel across at least 12 source groups not established; any later HCL requires separate authorization and pre-registration
